q.zh: 总的来说，你觉得自己的健康状况怎么样？
q.en: Would you say that in general your health is:

q.zh: 平常一周里，你做中等强度以上运动（快走、跑步、骑车、球类、健身）的时间合计多少分钟？
q.en: In a typical week, how many minutes of moderate or vigorous activity do you do (brisk walking, running, cycling, sports, gym)?

q.zh: 平均每 24 小时你睡多少小时？
q.en: On average, how many hours of sleep do you get in a 24-hour period?

q.zh: 下面这些事，你今天不停下来能做到的最难的一项是哪个？
q.en: Which is the hardest of these you could do today without stopping?

opts.zh: 正常速度走 1 英里（约 1.6 公里）
opts.en: Walk 1 mile at a normal pace

opts.zh: 因伤病或身体条件，这道题不适用
opts.en: Not applicable because of an injury or a physical condition

q.zh: 过去 30 天里，大约有多少天你因为身体或情绪不好，没法正常工作、学习或生活？
q.en: During the past 30 days, for about how many days did poor physical or mental health keep you from your usual activities, such as work, study or recreation?

q.zh: 平均每个月，你可以支配的钱一共有多少？把家人或伴侣给的、奖学金和自己挣的加在一起，包含房租，不含学费。
q.en: In an average month, how much money do you have to live on? Add up what family or a partner gives you, scholarships and what you earn; include rent and leave out tuition.

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你所在家庭的税前总收入是多少？
q.en: What was the total income of your household before taxes in the past 12 months?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你个人从公司得到的税前收入是多少？工资、分红和提款合计。
q.en: In the past 12 months, how much did you personally receive from your business before taxes? Count salary, dividends and drawings together.

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，扣除经营成本之后，你的税前净收入是多少？
q.en: In the past 12 months, what was your net income before taxes, after business costs?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你个人的税前总收入是多少？退休金、社保和投资收益合计。
q.en: What was your total personal income before taxes in the past 12 months? Count pensions, Social Security and investment income together.

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你个人的税前总收入是多少？工资、奖金等合计。
q.en: What was your total personal income before taxes in the past 12 months? Count wages, bonuses and similar together.

q.zh: 假如你突然需要支付一笔 $400 的紧急开支，你会怎么付？
q.en: Suppose you had an emergency expense of $400. How would you pay for it?

opts.en: I could not pay for it right now
By selling something or taking a loan
By borrowing from family or friends
With a credit card that I pay off over time

opts.zh: 用现金、存款，或者下个账单全额还清的信用卡
opts.en: With cash, money in my account, or a credit card I pay off in full

q.zh: 按现在的开支水平，不算退休金和社保，你的存款和投资够用多少年？
q.en: At your present level of spending, and leaving pensions and Social Security aside, how many years would your savings and investments last?

q.zh: 如果你主要的经济来源（包括家人或伴侣的支持）中断，你自己的存款够维持多久的开支？
q.en: If your main source of money stopped, including support from family or a partner, how long could you cover your expenses from your own savings?

q.zh: 按现在的开支，你的存款还能维持多久？
q.en: At your present level of spending, how long will your savings last?

q.zh: 如果失去主要收入来源，你的存款够维持多久的开支？
q.en: If you lost your main source of income, how long could you cover your expenses from savings?

q.zh: 把你名下的存款和投资加起来，减去信用卡欠款和私人借款，最接近哪个区间？学生贷款不算在内，另有一题单独问。
q.en: Add up the savings and investments in your name and subtract credit card balances and personal loans. Which range is closest? Leave out student loans, which are asked about separately.

q.zh: 把你拥有的（存款、投资、房产净值、车）加起来，减去你欠的（贷款、信用卡），最接近哪个区间？
q.en: Add up what you own (savings, investments, home equity, vehicles) and subtract what you owe (loans, credit cards). Which range is closest?

q.zh: 把你拥有的（存款、投资、房产净值、车）加起来，减去你欠的（贷款、信用卡），最接近哪个区间？
q.en: Add up what you own (savings, investments, home equity, vehicles) and subtract what you owe (loans, credit cards). Which range is closest?

q.zh: 把你拥有的（存款、投资、房产净值、车）加起来，减去你欠的（贷款、信用卡），最接近哪个区间？
q.en: Add up what you own (savings, investments, home equity, vehicles) and subtract what you owe (loans, credit cards). Which range is closest?

q.zh: 你每月的固定收入（退休金、社保、年金）能覆盖多大比例的日常开支？
q.en: How much of your day-to-day spending does your regular monthly income (pension, Social Security, annuities) cover?

opts.en: All of it, with money left over

q.zh: 到毕业时，你预计一共要背多少学生贷款？
q.en: How much student loan debt do you expect to have in total when you graduate?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你的税后收入里大约有多大比例存了下来或用于投资？
q.en: In the past 12 months, about what share of your after-tax income did you save or invest?

q.zh: 你家每月的收入里，大约有多大比例用来还债（房贷、车贷、信用卡、学生贷款）？
q.en: About what share of your household's monthly income goes to debt payments (mortgage, car loan, credit cards, student loans)?

q.zh: 你每月的收入里，大约有多大比例用来还债（房贷、车贷、信用卡、学生贷款）？
q.en: About what share of your monthly income goes to debt payments (mortgage, car loan, credit cards, student loans)?

q.zh: “我担心我现有的钱不够用到最后。”这句话在多大程度上符合你？
q.en: "I am concerned that the money I have will not last." How well does this describe you?

q.zh: 你多久会觉得，是钱在左右你的生活？
q.en: How often do you feel that your finances control your life?

q.zh: “我在经济上只是勉强维持。”这句话在多大程度上符合你？
q.en: "I am just getting by financially." How well does this describe you?

q.zh: 在你熟到可以请对方帮个小忙的人里，下面十类人覆盖了几类？教授或老师、已经工作的学长学姐、在你想进的行业里工作的人、创业者或企业主、公司里负责招聘的人、医生、律师、工程师或程序员、政府或公共部门的工作人员、博士生或科研人员。
q.en: Among people you know well enough to ask a small favour, how many of these ten kinds are covered? A professor or teacher, a graduate of your school who is now working, someone working in the industry you want to enter, a founder or business owner, someone who hires for a company, a doctor, a lawyer, an engineer or programmer, someone working in government or the public sector, a doctoral student or researcher.

q.zh: 在你熟到可以请对方帮个小忙的人里，下面十种职业覆盖了几种？医生、律师、软件工程师、护士、教师、警察或消防员、电工或水管工、雇有员工的企业主、公司高管、教授或科研人员。
q.en: Among people you know well enough to ask a small favour, how many of these ten occupations are covered? Doctor, lawyer, software engineer, nurse, teacher, police officer or firefighter, electrician or plumber, owner of a business with employees, senior executive, professor or scientist.

q.zh: 如果凌晨三点遇到严重的麻烦，你可以打电话给几个人？
q.en: How many people could you call at 3 a.m. if you had a serious problem?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：推荐一份实习或工作；借给你 $500；帮你修改简历或准备面试；把你介绍给你想进的行业里的人。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: recommend you for an internship or a job; lend you $500; help with your résumé or prepare you for an interview; introduce you to someone in the industry you want to enter? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：介绍一位客户或投资人；在你周转困难时借给你 $25,000；提供法律或税务方面的专业意见；加入你的团队，或者把合适的人推荐给你。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: introduce a client or an investor; lend you $25,000 in a cash squeeze; give you professional advice on law or tax; join your team, or recommend the right person for it? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：在你生病时照顾你几天；借给你 $5,000；提供法律、医疗或理财方面的建议；开车送你去医院或机场。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: look after you for a few days if you were ill; lend you $5,000; give you advice on law, health or money; drive you to a hospital or an airport? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：临时替你照看家人几个小时；借给你 $1,000；提供法律或医疗方面的建议；在你想工作的时候给你介绍机会。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: look after your family for a few hours at short notice; lend you $1,000; give you legal or medical advice; point you to an opening when you want to work? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：推荐一份工作；借给你 $1,000；提供法律或医疗方面的建议；把你引荐给你所在领域里能做决定的人。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: recommend you for a job; lend you $1,000; give you legal or medical advice; introduce you to a senior decision-maker in your field? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：推荐一份工作；借给你 $5,000；提供法律或医疗方面的建议；把你引荐给你所在领域里能做决定的人。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: recommend you for a job; lend you $5,000; give you legal or medical advice; introduce you to a senior decision-maker in your field? How many of the four?

q.zh: 如果你开口，是否有认识的人能帮你做下面四件事：推荐一份工作；借给你 $25,000；提供法律或医疗方面的建议；把你引荐给你所在领域里能做决定的人。四件里有几件？
q.en: Do you personally know someone who would do each of these if you asked: recommend you for a job; lend you $25,000; give you legal or medical advice; introduce you to a senior decision-maker in your field? How many of the four?

q.zh: 你积极参与的团体有几个（社团、球队、行业或学生组织、宗教或志愿团体）？
q.en: How many groups do you take an active part in (clubs, teams, professional or student organizations, faith or volunteer groups)?

q.zh: 你现在有没有在指导或帮助比你年轻的人，例如带徒弟、辅导功课、给人做顾问或在社区里做志愿者？
q.en: Do you now guide or help people younger than you, for example by training someone, tutoring, advising or volunteering in your community?

opts.zh: 这是我现在生活的重要部分
opts.en: It is an important part of my life now

q.zh: 你有没有导师或顾问，也就是比你有经验、并且在学业或事业上实际帮助你的人？
q.en: Do you have a mentor or an advisor: someone more experienced who actively helps your studies or career?

opts.en: Not now, but in the past
Yes, we talk a few times a year
Yes, we talk at least monthly

q.zh: 你多久会感到孤独？
q.en: How often do you feel lonely?

q.zh: 到目前为止，你最有分量的一段实践经历是什么？
q.en: What is the most substantial practical experience you have had so far?

opts.zh: 校内兼职、助教或志愿服务
opts.en: Campus job, teaching assistant or volunteering

opts.zh: 多段实习，或在学生组织、项目里担任负责人
opts.en: Several internships, or a leading role in a student organization or project

opts.zh: 创办过有用户或有收入的项目，或已拿到全职录用
opts.en: Founded a project with users or revenue, or hold a full-time offer

q.zh: 下面哪一项最符合你现在的工作？
q.en: Which best describes your current work?

opts.zh: 初级、服务或辅助性工作
技工、技术员或助理专业人员
opts.en: Skilled trade, technician or associate professional

opts.zh: 专业人员（如工程师、分析师、护士、教师）
opts.en: Professional (for example engineer, analyst, nurse, teacher)

opts.zh: 高管，或雇有员工的创始人

q.zh: 你的自由职业或个体经营现在处在什么阶段？
q.en: What stage is your freelance work or your own practice at?

opts.zh: 刚起步，还没有稳定的收入
opts.en: Just starting, with no steady income yet
Earning, but not enough to live on

opts.zh: 是我的主要收入，够我生活
opts.en: My main income, and enough to live on

opts.zh: 收入稳定，可以挑选项目或客户
opts.en: Steady income, and I can choose my projects or clients

opts.zh: 业务超出我一个人能接的量，已经开始外包或与人合作
opts.en: More work than I can take on alone, so I subcontract or work with partners

q.zh: 你的公司现在处在什么阶段？
q.en: What stage is your company at?

opts.zh: 盈利并且在扩张（新市场、新产品或新一轮融资）
opts.en: Profitable and expanding (new markets, new products or a new round of funding)

q.zh: 退休前，你的主要工作属于哪一类？
q.en: Which best describes your main job before you retired?

opts.en: I did not have a regular job

opts.zh: 初级、服务或辅助性工作
技工、技术员或助理专业人员
opts.en: Skilled trade, technician or associate professional

opts.zh: 专业人员（如工程师、分析师、护士、教师）
opts.en: Professional (for example engineer, analyst, nurse, teacher)

opts.zh: 高管，或雇有员工的创始人

q.zh: 你最近一份工作属于哪一类？
q.en: Which best describes your most recent job?

opts.en: I have not had a job yet

opts.zh: 初级、服务或辅助性工作
技工、技术员或助理专业人员
opts.en: Skilled trade, technician or associate professional

opts.zh: 专业人员（如工程师、分析师、护士、教师）
opts.en: Professional (for example engineer, analyst, nurse, teacher)

opts.zh: 高管，或雇有员工的创始人

q.zh: 在你的专业课里，你大致处在什么水平？
q.en: Where do you stand in the courses of your subject?

opts.en: Above the middle of the class

opts.zh: 名列前茅，并且在竞赛、科研或作品上有成果
opts.en: Near the top, with results in competitions, research or a portfolio

q.zh: 在你的研究或专业方向上，你现在处在什么水平？
q.en: Where do you stand in your area of research or professional study?

opts.zh: 能在指导下完成课题或案例
opts.en: I complete projects or cases under supervision

opts.zh: 能独立完成课题或项目
opts.en: I complete projects on my own

opts.zh: 有发表、获奖或被采用的成果
opts.en: I have work that was published, awarded or put to use

opts.zh: 在这个方向上有一定名气：受邀报告、审稿或合作
opts.en: Known in the area: invited to present, review or collaborate

q.zh: 退休前，你在自己这一行里达到了什么水平？
q.en: What level had you reached in your line of work before you retired?

opts.zh: 能独立完成常规的工作
opts.en: I complete routine work on my own

opts.zh: 能独立处理没遇到过的问题
opts.en: I handle problems I have not met before on my own

opts.zh: 别人会来请教我，我带过新人
opts.en: Others come to me for advice, and I have trained newcomers

opts.zh: 在行业里有一定名气：受邀分享、评审或参与制定标准
opts.en: Known in the field: invited to speak, judge or help set standards

q.zh: 在你的主要工作领域里，下面哪一项最符合你现在的水平？
q.en: In your main field of work, which best describes your present level?

opts.zh: 刚入门，需要别人带着做
opts.en: Starting out: I need guidance from others

opts.zh: 能独立完成常规的工作
opts.en: I complete routine work on my own

opts.zh: 能独立处理没遇到过的问题
opts.en: I handle problems I have not met before on my own

opts.zh: 别人会来请教我，我带过新人
opts.en: Others come to me for advice, and I have trained newcomers

opts.zh: 在行业里有一定名气：受邀分享、评审或参与制定标准
opts.en: Known in the field: invited to speak, judge or help set standards

q.zh: 你已经完成的最高学历是什么？
q.en: What is the highest level of education you have completed?

opts.zh: 大学肄业、副学士或职业学校证书
opts.en: Some college, associate degree or trade school certificate
Master's or professional degree (MBA, JD, MD)

q.zh: 你的学业或专业成果有没有得到过正式认可（奖学金、荣誉学位、发表的论文、专利、行业奖项）？
q.en: Have you received formal recognition for academic or professional work (scholarship, honours, published paper, patent, industry award)?

opts.en: One, at school or local level
Several, at school or local level
Several, at national or international level

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如云计算或网络安全认证、PE 工程师执照、PMP）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example cloud or security certifications, a PE licence, PMP)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如CPA、CFA、PMP、证券从业资格）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example CPA, CFA, PMP, securities licences)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如律师执照、专利代理人资格）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example bar admission, patent agent registration)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如护士执照 RN、医师执照、专科认证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example RN, a medical licence, board certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如教师资格证、学科或语言教学认证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example a teaching credential, subject or language teaching certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如乐器或舞蹈等级证书、设计软件认证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example graded music or dance exams, design software certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如教练或裁判证书、私人教练认证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example coaching or referee certification, personal trainer certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如房地产经纪执照、保险销售执照、食品安全经理证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example a real estate licence, an insurance licence, food safety manager certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如电工或水管工执照、焊接认证、暖通空调执照）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example an electrician's or plumber's licence, welding certification, an HVAC licence)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如商业驾照 CDL、飞行执照、叉车操作证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example a commercial driver's licence, a pilot's licence, forklift certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如急救员 EMT 认证、执法或消防资格）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example EMT certification, law enforcement or firefighter certification)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如社工执照、心理咨询执照）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example a social work licence, a counselling licence)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如农药施用执照、兽医技师执照）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example a pesticide applicator's licence, a veterinary technician's licence)?

q.zh: 你持有几项需要通过考试才能取得的专业执照或证书（例如CPA、律师执照、护士执照、电工执照、商业驾照、云计算认证）？
q.en: How many professional licences or certifications do you hold that required an exam (for example CPA, bar admission, RN, an electrician's licence, a commercial driver's licence, cloud certification)?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你参加了大约多少小时的课程、讲座或培训？兴趣班和老年大学也算。
q.en: In the past 12 months, about how many hours of courses, lectures or training did you attend? Hobby classes and lifelong-learning programmes count.

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，在必修课程之外，你完成了大约多少小时的系统学习（网课、培训、工作坊）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, about how many hours of structured learning did you complete beyond your required courses (online courses, training, workshops)?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，你完成了大约多少小时的系统学习（课程、培训、工作坊）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, about how many hours of structured learning did you complete (courses, training, workshops)?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，在日常工作之外，你完成了大约多少小时的系统学习（课程、培训、工作坊）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, about how many hours of structured learning did you complete beyond your day-to-day work (courses, training, workshops)?

q.zh: 你能用几种语言流利地交流，达到可以用来工作或办事的程度？
q.en: In how many languages can you communicate fluently, well enough to work or handle everyday business in them?

opts.en: One, and I am learning another

q.zh: 不靠别人帮忙，你在电脑上能做到的最高级的事情是哪一项？
q.en: What is the most advanced thing you can do on a computer without help?

opts.en: Use email, apps and web search

opts.zh: 做带公式的表格，或者剪辑照片和视频
opts.en: Build a spreadsheet with formulas, or edit photos or video

opts.zh: 分析数据或者把重复的工作自动化（数据透视表、SQL、无代码工具）
opts.en: Analyse data or automate a task (pivot tables, SQL, no-code tools)

opts.zh: 写出能运行的代码或脚本
开发并发布软件，或者带领技术项目
opts.en: Build and release software, or lead a technical project

q.zh: 假设你在储蓄账户里存了 $100，年利率 2%。把钱一直放着，5 年后账户里有多少钱？
q.en: Suppose you had $100 in a savings account and the interest rate was 2% per year. After 5 years, how much would you have if you left the money to grow?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，有没有人为你的经验或技能付过钱（顾问、兼职、授课、手艺）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, has anyone paid you for your experience or a skill (consulting, part-time work, teaching, a craft)?

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，在正式工作或学业之外，有没有人为你的某项技能付过钱（接私活、家教、设计、编程、教练、演出）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, has anyone paid you for a skill outside a regular job or your studies (freelance work, tutoring, design, coding, coaching, performing)?

opts.zh: 经常有，占收入的相当一部分
opts.en: Regularly, a meaningful part of my income

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，有没有人为你的某项技能付过钱（接活、家教、设计、编程、教练、手艺）？
q.en: In the past 12 months, has anyone paid you for a skill (odd jobs, tutoring, design, coding, coaching, a craft)?

opts.zh: 经常有，占收入的相当一部分
opts.en: Regularly, a meaningful part of my income

q.zh: 除你自己以外，你的公司现在有多少人（全职和兼职都算）？
q.en: Apart from you, how many people work in your company now, full-time and part-time?

q.zh: 直接或间接向你汇报的有多少人？
q.en: How many people report to you, directly or indirectly?

q.zh: 你的客户或订单主要是怎么来的？
q.en: Where do most of your clients or orders come from?

opts.en: Mostly introductions from people I know

opts.zh: 老客户的复购和转介绍占多数
opts.en: Mostly repeat business and referrals from clients

opts.zh: 客户主动找来，需要排期或挑选
opts.en: Clients come to me, and I schedule or choose among them

q.zh: 过去 12 个月，有没有别的公司或机构请你担任顾问、董事、导师，或者请你去分享经验？
q.en: In the past 12 months, has another company or organization asked you to act as an advisor, board member or mentor, or to speak about your experience?

opts.zh: 这是我收入的重要来源
opts.en: It is an important part of my income

q.zh: 你在任何一项爱好上达到过的最高水平是什么（运动、音乐、美术、手工、棋类、烹饪、游戏）？
q.en: What is the highest level you have reached in any pursuit of your own (a sport, music, art, craft, chess, cooking, a game)?

opts.zh: 高级：在本地演出、展览或比赛
opts.en: Advanced: I perform, exhibit or compete locally

opts.zh: 专业：有人付费、授课，或参加全国级比赛
opts.en: Expert: I am paid, teach, or compete nationally

q.zh: 总的来说，你对现在的生活有多满意？（0 分完全不满意，10 分完全满意）
q.en: Overall, how satisfied are you with your life nowadays? (0 is not at all, 10 is completely)

q.zh: 总的来说，你觉得自己在生活中做的事情有多大的价值？（0 分完全没有，10 分非常有价值）
q.en: Overall, to what extent do you feel that the things you do in your life are worthwhile? (0 is not at all, 10 is completely)

q.zh: 过去两周，你有多少天感到紧张、焦虑或心神不宁？
q.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling nervous, anxious or on edge?

q.zh: 过去两周，你有多少天做什么事都提不起兴趣、感受不到乐趣？
q.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by little interest or pleasure in doing things?

q.zh: 事情出了岔子之后，你通常要多久才能回到正轨？
q.en: When something goes wrong, how long does it usually take you to get back on track?

q.zh: 过去一个月，你有多经常觉得生活中重要的事情在自己的掌控之中？
q.en: In the past month, how often have you felt in control of the important things in your life?

q.zh: 想象一架十级的梯子，代表美国社会中人们所处的位置。最上面是境况最好的人：钱最多、学历最高、工作最好。最下面是境况最差的人。你觉得自己站在第几级？
q.en: Think of a ladder with 10 rungs representing where people stand in the United States. At the top are the people who are best off: most money, most education, best jobs. At the bottom are those who are worst off. Which rung are you on?
